name: ATL Permission Guard
description: Verifies agent actions against the Agent Trust Layer before execution. Enforces scoped UCAN-based capability delegations.

serverUrl.description: URL of the ATL server (e.g. http://localhost:3000)

grantId.description: UUID of the active ATL delegation (grant_id) for this agent

sessionTtlSeconds.description: How long minted session keys live (seconds)

port.description: Local HTTP port the plugin listens on for /atl/verify calls from skills

toolMappings.description: Map of OpenClaw tool names to ATL resource/action. Merged with built-in defaults.
